intro: Foundations is only a starting point. These trusted resources go deeper. The links open other websites. Book links go to Open Library, so you can find a copy at a library or bookshop.

items.title: BibleProject
items.description: Free animated videos, podcasts and classes that walk through every book of the Bible and its big themes. A wonderful companion to this app.

items.title: BiblicalTraining.org
items.description: Free seminary-level classes from respected teachers, on the Bible, theology and church history. Great for when you want to go much deeper.

items.title: Christian History Institute
items.description: Free issues of Christian History magazine, readable articles on people and events from every era.

items.title: Bible Gateway
items.description: Read and compare dozens of translations, including the NKJV, ESV, NLT and CSB, side by side.

items.title: YouVersion Bible App
items.description: A free Bible app with many translations, audio Bibles and reading plans.

items.title: STEP Bible
items.description: Free study tools from Tyndale House, Cambridge, that let you see the Hebrew and Greek words behind any English translation.

items.title: Blue Letter Bible
items.description: Free word-study tools, commentaries and original-language helps.

sections.title: Manuscripts and the history of the text

items.title: Leon Levy Dead Sea Scrolls Digital Library
items.description: High-resolution images of the Dead Sea Scrolls from the Israel Antiquities Authority.

items.title: Center for the Study of New Testament Manuscripts
items.description: Photographs of ancient Greek New Testament manuscripts that you can browse for free.

items.title: The Drama of Scripture
items.description: The whole Bible told as one unfolding story in six acts.

items.title: God's Big Picture
items.description: A short, clear overview of how the Bible fits together around the theme of God's kingdom.

items.title: Basic Christianity
items.description: A classic, short introduction to who Jesus is and what it means to follow him.

sections.title: Books: how to read the Bible

items.title: How to Read the Bible for All Its Worth
items.description: The best-known beginner's guide to reading each genre of the Bible well.

items.title: How to Read the Bible Book by Book
items.description: A guided tour of every book: what it is about and how to read it.

items.title: Grasping God's Word
items.by: J. Scott Duvall and J. Daniel Hays
items.description: A hands-on workbook for learning to study a passage step by step.

sections.title: Books: how we got the Bible

items.title: How We Got the Bible
items.description: A friendly introduction to manuscripts, canon and translation.

items.title: The Canon of Scripture
items.description: A respected scholar's account of how the books of the Bible were recognised.

items.title: Myths and Mistakes in New Testament Textual Criticism
items.description: For later: careful scholars correct common misunderstandings about manuscripts.

items.title: Church History in Plain Language
items.description: Two thousand years of church history told clearly for ordinary readers.

items.title: The Story of Christianity
items.description: A highly readable two-volume history of the church from the early centuries to today.

items.title: Turning Points: Decisive Moments in the History of Christianity
items.description: Twelve key moments that shaped the church, explained by a leading historian.

sections.title: Understanding each tradition in its own words
sections.intro: Learning how each tradition explains itself is one of the fairest ways to understand Christians who differ from you.

items.title: The Orthodox Church
items.description: The classic introduction to Eastern Orthodox history and belief, by an Orthodox bishop.

items.title: Catechism of the Catholic Church
items.description: The official summary of Catholic teaching, free on the Vatican website.

items.title: Christianity's Dangerous Idea
items.description: A history of Protestantism, from the Reformation to today's global movements.
